snippet.title: Sky Patch: Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Sky Patch is a peaceful 3D farming platformer and puzzle adventure where players must revitalize quiet, floating islands.

Developed in 20 days for 2025 Solarpunk Jam.
Play today on itch.io: https://nulljamgames.itch.io/sky-patch
